shortDescription.text: Transaction signing for 1 chain(s) relies on elliptic-curve signatures

fullDescription.text: The wallet's message definitions cover Monero. These chains authorize transactions with Ed25519, which Shor's algorithm breaks on a cryptographically relevant quantum computer. A wallet cannot move a chain to post-quantum signatures on its own: the chain has to adopt a scheme first. Follow each chain's post-quantum roadmap, avoid public-key reuse, and keep signers ready to add post-quantum signature schemes as chains adopt them. Keep the signing layer crypto-agile per chain (algorithm identifiers in messages and storage, room for larger keys and signatures) and track each chain's post-quantum proposals, so that a new scheme can be added when a chain activates it.
